title: Reasoning links INPUT editor profile (empty text allowed; null dimension is a valid observation reference)
description: Optional editor documentation, not an import-ready checker or a generated review report. No discriminator exists in this input: choose by editor file association; never insert $schema or version. Empty arrays are valid no-declaration states; empty or whitespace-only strings are unfinished where Python requires nonblank text. No relation, role, action or judgement is inferred: transcribe only explicitly supplied choices. Shape is not binding freshness, semantic support, scientific validation, authenticated review or permission. See docs/LINK_DESIGN_EDITOR_SCHEMAS.md.

observation_index.description: JSON Schema integer accepts integral numbers such as 0.0; Python requires an exact int, not bool or float, and an existing index. Not a stable cross-build identity.
